title: Behavior Stomp Turtle Egg
description: Allows this mob to stomp turtle eggs

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

goal_radius.description: Distance in blocks at which the entity is considered to have reached the egg.

interval.description: Time in ticks between stomp attempts.

search_count.description: Maximum number of blocks to search.

speed_multiplier.description: Movement speed multiplier while looking for eggs.
